verdict.rationale: Kintsugi documents its own CSV file upload that imports many sales transactions at once for onboarding or backfilling, which is a first-party bulk ingest capability. Nothing shows bulk edit, delete, or reclassify actions, or a batch API endpoint, across items. Missing for 10: bulk update/delete/reclassify operations, batch API endpoints for AI-driven bulk actions, bulk operations beyond transaction import (e.g., exemptions, products, registrations), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: File upload imports sales transactions from a CSV, which is the fastest way to bring in history when you are onboarding or backfilling a period.
